caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with a rectangular form and a natural wood-brown color, featuring three large horizontal drawers stacked vertically in the lower section and a smaller upper section with two smaller drawers. Each drawer is fitted with two round knobs, also rendered in a similar brown tone, for a total of ten knobs visible. The smaller upper section sits centered on top of the larger base, creating a stepped appearance. The entire dresser is shown in three-quarter perspective, revealing details of the wood grain texture. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or décor present, and there is a small inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Dresser
